subject: Civil Engineering
title: The Water Cycle in Engineering
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Water Cycle in Engineering.

hook.text: Every drop of rain was once ocean water. Engineers track where that drop goes next.

buildup.text: Evaporation lifts water. Clouds carry it. Rain falls. Rivers return it to the sea.

discovery.text: Only 2.5% of Earth's water is fresh — and most of that is locked in ice caps.

twist.text: Humans intercept the cycle everywhere — dams, wells, irrigation, and cities alter flow.

climax.text: Water resource engineers balance supply and demand across the entire cycle.

punchline.text: Nature moves water. Engineers decide who gets it and when.

quiz.question: What percentage of Earth's water is fresh?
